data.headline: SENIOR R&D EXECUTIVE | NEW PRODUCT R&D | MEDICAL DEVICE ENGINEERING | PRODUCT STRATEGY | HIGH-PERFOMANCE GLOBAL TEAM BUILDING
data.about:
LEVERAGING ADVANCES IN SOFTWARE, FIRMWARE, AND HARDWARE TECHNOLOGY TO DELIVER DISRUPTIVE AWARD-WINNING MEDICAL DEVICES

As a visionary Senior R&D Executive I am best known for driving award-winning technology-based product innovation fueled by forward-looking R&D. I have been particularly effective in envisioning and delivering next generation MedTech product platforms that effectively address major healthcare challenges while improving the patient’s quality of life. 

Those I have worked with or led will tell you that I am at my best when I am taking disruptive products from concept to global award-winning solutions that drive growth in revenue and profitability while consistently delivering sustainable value to the company and the customer. Some notable contributions include:

•	Delivering the software, system, and user experience for the award-winning VERO GENOSYL DS product used in critical care units to improve breathing in premature babies, adults, and COVID patients. 
•	Inventing diabetes care products and systems including global blood (BGM) glucose monitoring systems now used around the world.
•	Creating the technology behind Bayer/Ascencia’s next-gen Contour ONE Blood Glucose Meters utilized by > 25 million diabetes patients around the globe and in experiments on the International Space Station. 
•	Building and leading led award-winning, world-class, multidisciplinary teams and software development organizations at VERO Biotech, Ascencia Diabetes Care, and Bayer Healthcare that pioneered technological advances driving development of award-winning lifesaving medical devices. 
•	Guiding professionals and teaming with strategic business partners in countries including Japan, India, China, Canada, Costa Rica, and Switzerland.

If you seek the expertise and leadership of high-performance global team builder and team leader who gets the best out of diverse, cross-functional, cross-cultural, teams and global partners to optimize technology and raise the bar for product functionality, please feel free to link up with me.

Skills: Technology Thought Leadership | Next Gen Product Design & UX | Firmware and Software Development | SaaS | Mobile Applications | Software Systems Engineering | Systems Engineering & Integration | FDA Compliance | Technology Risk Burndown | AI | Business Intelligence | Cybersecurity | Business Partnering and Technology Integration | Project and Program Management| Budget Planning and Management | Process Improvement and Engineering | Strategic Partnerships | Azure DevOps | Agile | SAFe | CE | CI | CD

description.text: Brought onboard to lead System Design, System Integration, User Experience and Human Factors Engineering activities within Neuromodulation R&D.

Recruited by company leadership to establish a cohesive, software development organization and processes deemed critical to the viability of this startup company offering The First Tankless Inhaled Nitric Oxide Delivery System utilized to ease breathing at a time when Covid hospitalizations and respiratory challenges in the US were peaking. Oversaw FDA clearance and delivery of next generation drug delivery system software with a pathway for connectivity.

•	Built and sustained a global Agile software and firmware development team. Added system engineering and verification test team members as well as global partners to augment Software and Firmware developers. 
•	Utilized an Agile sprint planning process to transform the team with results instrumental to winning the “PREMIER INNOVATION Technological Breakthrough” award for VERO’s GENOSYL DS solution.
•	Planned and directed an upgrade of the main GENOSYL DS application to improve system reliability, deliver an award-winning user experience, and add substantial new functionalities. 
•	Established new global partnerships and developed Full Stack Software solutions that dramatically simplified and streamlined paper-based business processes while delivering strategic business intelligence and analytics.

Retained by the senior management of this standalone company launched in 2016 following a KKR/Panasonic-driven acquisition of Bayer Diabetes Care, an SBU of Bayer Healthcare LLC. Led development of connected diabetes hardware and software systems that enabled this new company to leapfrog industry competitors and sustain a top ranking in its industry niche while dramatically improving the lives of patients with diabetes. 
•	Enabled strategic technology innovation essential to new product development Oversaw a multidisciplinary, multicultural team involved in system design and engineering operations across multiple countries. Guided an Electrical Design team that provided analog, digital, and RF circuit input to Bluetooth Low Energy and analog chip manufacturers as part of their next-gen silicon roadmaps. 
	 
•	Fueled the global launch of Contour Next One Blood Glucose Meter with Contour Diabetes app availability on Apple and Android phones in >50 countries and >27 languages. 
•	Earned kudos for delivering a medical device with the best accuracy in the industry enabling its deployment to the International Space Station for use on experiments. 
•	Designed and delivered innovative product concepts and rapid technology prototypes. Drove comprehensive design of BGM and CGM system platform architectures, technology development, and engineering activities.

Directed Diabetes Care Product Engineering R&D efforts spanning Systems Engineering, Design and Human Factors, Medical Device Engineering, and Full-Stack Application Software. Guided as many as 100 professionals in new platform development teams operating out of > 3 countries. Responsibly managed an eight-figure budget.

•	Streamlined core product engineering processes and communication strategies essential to product engineering implemented on a global scale. Built harmonious relationships that facilitated a successful market launch to >50 countries.
•	Fueled a new product launch that generated substantial new revenues. Developed and launched Ascensia Diabetes Care’s flagship, best in class, Contour ONE Blood Glucose Meter with Bluetooth full stack connectivity to a first-ever Contour branded mobile application and cloud services platform now used in Apple and Android phones and available in >27 languages.
•	Built a world class team. Completely rebuilt the R&D Organization and updated skills that played a critical role in the successful development and launch of the Contour ONE Blood Glucose Meter.

description.text:
Led system development and integration activities between Bayer and Medtronic that enabled Bayer’s Contour Next / Plus Link Blood Glucose Meters to communicate seamlessly with Medtronic’s Insulin Pumps. Directed a team of >25 software, firmware, and electrical engineers. Served as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to Bayer senior management as well as key global suppliers and clients while providing technical leadership focused on driving business growth and increasing revenue generation. 

•	Served as an SME in medical device software development as well as in global multi-site, multi-organizational product development and delivery. 
•	Brought Medtronic deliverables back on track and enabled successful product delivery. Implemented a planning approach that delivered aggressive project plan commitments that were met by a global team in US and Japan.

Led a global, multi-site system integration team in design and delivery of next-gen Smart TVs for Tier 1 manufacturers. including Vizio. Led systems integration efforts that facilitated the launch of its flagship VIA Connected TV product line supported by TV ads run during the Super Bowl and Vancouver Winter Olympics.
Led design, development, and integration of leading-edge HDTV technologies. AMD High-Definition TV (HDTV) division was acquired and integrated into Broadcom Corporation
ATI Research was acquired by AMD
Drove development of color systems architecture and next gen technology platform for Sharp’s color copier/printers.
